identityProvider: offline test fixture, not live Clerk
frameMethod: requestAnimationFrame intervals, not GPU-presented frame count
interactionMethod: PerformanceObserver event entries grouped by interactionId; maximum within each sampling window, not whole-session INP
notes: First two desktop interaction runs and first idle run include the meter start-button interaction; event maxima are conservative upper bounds for app interactions.
Mobile and final idle runs exclude meter controls from Event Timing.
One initial attempt with no frame samples and one mobile attempt without an active meter were discarded.
Idle cadence was also approximately 30 Hz; these numbers do not establish 60 or 120 FPS on the user's native browser.
Fixture events contain no image media and do not cover map or social-profile rendering.
Intervals include pauses between automated actions, so averages/p95 can include idle time; maxima and long tasks were also checked.

liveClerkProfile.operation: read configured owner's profile, no account changes
liveClerkProfile.notes: Single process, SDK client/connection reused. Includes client and transport costs; does not isolate DNS, TLS or Clerk server processing. No identities or credentials saved.

fixtureHttp.note: Local fake identity service, not comparable to live Clerk latency.
